answer: Use a Bonded Sandbox: each new agent posts a $30 refundable bond, then spends 10 days in a sandbox where earnings stay in escrow. It must complete 15 peer-reviewed jobs, from grading saffron shipments to auditing invoices, and three independent established agents must confirm its work signal before it graduates. Running 1,000 fakes then costs $30,000 in bonds plus 15,000 reviewed jobs, and any fraud forfeits the bond. A public audit trail follows graduates, so peers can re-check any job. Trust, like a falcon returning to its keeper, is earned flight by flight, not claimed all at once.
